name: Evershine
summary: At Steelgrill's Depot near Kharanos, Pilot Bellowfiz needs Evershine from Rejold Barleybrew in Brewnall Village. The strong brew warms him and can fuel his siege engine, Jetsteam.

sections.title: A Potent Concoction
sections.body: Rejold Barleybrew's brewing experiments go beyond ordinary dwarven ales. Evershine can knock all but the hardiest dwarves flat, yet its heat is prized in Dun Morogh's bitter cold.

sections.title: Fuel for Pilot Bellowfiz
sections.body: At Steelgrill's Depot outside Kharanos, Pilot Bellowfiz takes a warming sip of Evershine against the freezing winds. The volatile brew can also feed Jetsteam's furnace. When Bellowfiz is in a tight spot, it gives his siege engine an explosive burst of emergency power.

aliases: what kind of drink is evershine
faq.answer: Evershine is an exceptionally strong experimental brew made by the dwarven brewer Rejold Barleybrew in Brewnall Village. Its fiery strength can fell even hardy dwarven drinkers.

faq.q: Why does Pilot Bellowfiz want Evershine?
faq.answer: Pilot Bellowfiz drinks Evershine to warm himself against Dun Morogh's chill and uses it as emergency fuel. In Jetsteam's furnace, the volatile spirit gives the siege engine an immediate burst of power.
Brewnall Village lies in western Dun Morogh, along the road west of Kharanos. Brewers such as Rejold Barleybrew live there near the snowy hills.
Rejold Barleybrew is an experimental dwarven brewer in Brewnall Village. He makes many drinks, from pleasant ales to fierce brews potent enough to ignite machine furnaces.

faq.q: What comes next after reaching Rejold Barleybrew?
faq.answer: Rejold needs help before he will hand over his liquor. At Brewnall Village, you find A Favor for Evershine, where you help the brewer before he gives you a cask for Pilot Bellowfiz.

faq.q: Is Evershine truly safe to drink?
faq.answer: Pilot Bellowfiz says Evershine will flatten almost any dwarf who tries it. The strongest mountain folk can drink it, but its extreme flammability also makes it useful in an engine furnace.

angles.text: As a gnome, you may appreciate how Pilot Bellowfiz turns ordinary things, even dwarven brew, into improvised fuel.
As a dwarf, you know the fiery extremes of dwarven brewing, and Rejold Barleybrew's spirit brings them to Dun Morogh's cold peaks.
As an engineer, you can see how volatile spirits give pilots like Bellowfiz another way to keep siege engines running in harsh conditions.
